speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, could you describe the location and nature of your headache, and specify which eye or both eyes are experiencing the vision loss?

speaker: Patient
text: 69-year-old woman. The patient reports a 3-week history of headache and progressively worsening vision. She has not noticed any other symptoms, including no recent weight changes, no fevers, no night sweats, and no pain elsewhere in the body.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the pain localize to your temples, and do you experience any tenderness when you touch or comb your hair? Have you noticed any jaw pain or difficulty chewing, especially when eating hard foods?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Headache. I also have Worsening vision over the past 3 weeks, No weight changes, No fevers, No night sweats, No other pain.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience jaw pain or difficulty chewing when eating hard foods, and have you noticed any scalp tenderness when combing your hair? I also need to know if you have been taking any new medications recently.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: The patient has hypertension, which is controlled with medication. She also has a history of high cholesterol. Social history: Retired school teacher. Non-smoker and drinks alcohol socially. No recreational drug use.

speaker: Doctor
text: You mentioned having hypertension and high cholesterol, but I haven't heard about jaw claudication or scalp tenderness yet. Do you experience pain in your jaw while chewing or tenderness when you touch your scalp? REQUEST TEST: ESR

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal ESR is surprising given your age and symptoms, so I need to check if inflammation is present elsewhere. REQUEST TEST: CRP

speaker: Doctor
text: Despite the normal ESR, the elevated CRP and your symptoms of headache and vision loss in a patient over 60 strongly suggest Giant Cell Arteritis. I need to visualize the temporal arteries to confirm this suspicion. REQUEST TEST: Temporal Artery Ultrasound
